reviews.text: Watch out for sneaky parking wardens,  parking meter opposite. PDSA

The PDSA are fantastic, a wonderful service. I take all my pets there as all the staff are friendly& helpful, the vets are knowledgable and empathetic, plus the costs are reasonable.
(They also offer a free service if you are eligible.) I don’t know what I’d do without them.
Obviously it does get busy sometimes and you wait over appointment time.
Please give them a donation if you are thinking of giving to a charity!

Absolute dump every time I’ve had an appointment I’ve been made to wait hours. Paid appointments that when showing up at the time can’t accommodate. Manager seriously needs to get her staff in order. Couldn’t put a nut in a monkeys mouth.

I was registered with the PDSA many years ago and when I had to register again I had no issues with it as I understand that many people dont unregister when pets pass or they move away which means unknown empty slots are kept from others in desperate need.

Giving clients 3 years grace of no use of them is plenty time!

I have read many people moaning about it but at the end of the day that is on them and not the charity.

I moved back to Glasgow in February and was once more in need of their help for my Dog, I had been trying to register her since February with no luck.

I was worried as I have never been in a situation that my pets werent covered for their health.

Months later.
Tikanni got a little over excited showing my elderly cat her new teddy and Shyla just wasnt in the mood and struck her in the eye with her claw.

I called the PDSA and got through to their after hrs team, I explained I still hadn't got her a space with them as they have been full up.

Luckily for us a space had just become available and I was sent to their after hrs vet hospital in town.

They were wonderful with her.
They took the time to build some trust with her and once they had she just loved on them and let them do everything they needed to do to ensure her eye wasnt going to be lost.

She had check ups at shamrock street also and they too were wonderful with her, they took time to build a trust, they didnt force her on anything.

All is well with Tikanni now and the day she got the cone of shame off, the first thing she done was grab that teddy and run to shyla with it to show her, this time shyla was more receptive.
They treat animals with great care and compassion, and always strive to help.
Really friendly and helpful assistance as always. Thank you PDSA

The reception girl was really cheeky we were late but we phoned up before us arriving saying we would be late because of something else and then we got there the reception try’d to charge us 100 pounds for being late after phoning up it’s a disgrace
Really appreciated the vets analysis and care while dealing with my mother's wee dog.

I would like to thank Erin,( I think the vet was called?), for explaining everything thoroughly  and showing empathy x
Also Antonio who was lovely, very caring, gentle and helped my girl, Bella, to be free from suffering x
I'll never forget you Bella xx
Easy access and parking outside
Had to call for an emergency appointment due to my cat being old and not well. They were very helpful and kind took us in right away. Cat peacefully put to rest. Thank you
Always amazing I'm so glad n thankful for the pdsa x
Very caring staff who have to deal with some difficult customers. Great service from them.

We had to put our beautiful girl down last Friday. The veterinarian who handled her euthanasia was amazing, and I can’t explain how grateful we are that we had at least one kind face in that whole practice. However, the receptionist and her attitude were nothing short of disgusting. We asked which room our girl was in because she had to go in through a side door, and we got told she had already been discharged, despite us watching our dog walk through the side door five minutes prior. She then said she would go look for her, and we made the stupid decision of letting her. The receptionist came back and informed us our unmissable husky was in fact not in that practice. She then said to us in a dismissive tone, 'Go have a look for yourself then.' So we did, and found her in the very first room to the left. Now, as I said, she’s not a small dog; she was quite literally not missable if you had properly looked in the room. On top of that, whilst my mum was booking her in, she was bombarded with questions about if she was going to donate to the charity. She would’ve had no problems with this if it hadn't been at the same time that she was walking to the room to say goodbye to our fur baby. I’m writing this because I think your receptionist has no place working with the public, never mind in a setting where people say goodbye to their beloved pets, her attitude was disgusting and she added unnecessary distress to a situation that was already distressing for me and my whole family.
Absolutely fabulous vets
Good people trying to help, best to phone and get a time to visit,

The vets and staff are brilliant!
I wish all other vets had the same compassion and love for animals as the PDSA does.
Great service and care and they genuinely care about all their patients, and it shows.
Thank you for all you do!
🐶🐱🐰🐭🐹❤️
We appreciate the PDSA.
My cat has mammary tumours, they were very good with their advice and with the choice of how to deal with it. I am very happy with how they dealt with my cat.
Great service and take within 5mins with an appointment the place was bizi
Had a 9am appointment which was a better time as they weren't running too late. Staff were nice, friendly and informative.
Great place, been great with the dogs I've had. Super staff
It's a charitable organisation to assist animals not a lot more can be said
staff are most helpful

PDSA shamrock street are brilliant. My cat gets ubi every 3 months and a get stressed out and my cat gets stressed out as well. A told the vet last time a was there and she made arrangements for me to pick up a repeat prescription every 3 months. No more stress
Most helpful staff I can't praze them enough, unfortunately the council charges parking in a time of distress when your pet is unwell, this I find very disrespectful

Our dog needed help after having a collision accident. The staff at Shamrock Street were absolutely amazing.
Thank you 🙏🏻 …
Very caring and good for people who have low income

I have used the PDSA several times over the years and always had a great experience. Free health treatments for people on qualifying benefits but you must register in advance and renew every year and you do pay for neutering and vaccines at a discounted price. You are always asked for a donation so if you can afford then do donate if you can’t then just tell them you can’t, there is no pressure. They helped me say goodbye to my much loved cat who had long term health issues for several years and they were just as compassionate as the private vet we used the year before.

Excellent. Emma really helped us. Our wee Pug Leia was suffering a lot back legs going blind in her right eye then this morning her wee front leg went & she couldn't stand. We loved her so much & didn't want her to suffer.
We'll miss her so much.
They do the best they can with what resources they have.
Very poor as wanted 2 register. Did the process on line no information of staff shortage.  Disgusting really. Same for the fone no info
Just the best payed or not THE BEST!!!!!!

I had to get my dog put down here on Friday, and the vet that did it was very supporting, made sure we had enough time to say goodbye and was extremely kind and patient. She let us know everything she was doing and talked us through it. She brought out some towels and blankets for Lacey and explained how things would go once she had gotten the anaesthetic. At the end, she offered for some of the nurses to get us paw prints in a small card to take home with us. Not a pleasant experience but as pleasant as they could have made it.
Amazing staff xx
Best vet's I've ever had the pleasure of trusting with my beloved pets. They know exactly what to do in no time and they work so hard. I always make sure I tell them how much they are appreciated.
I’ve been bringing my freinds cat for a few years
They are fantastic and very helpful

Had to use a few times. And emergency also.   As the emergency was out of hours I was directed to the animal hospital.  They had called ahead to say I was coming over.   The receptionist was good at her job  and the vets where 10/10. I came back in the morning to collect my dog  all better again
Fantastic resource with Fantastic staff.
A place where every pet will find the helping hand of an angel. The best veterinarians

Vet was amazing , staff do there best ,
Gave 2 stars less , due to owners n dogs having dog in the cat area on 2 separate  occasions.  And staff not saying to keep them in dog area , out cats and other cats became distressed.  Also when one time went to a already booked and paid in full in advance appointment  for my 2 pets to be fixed i was not told on the day i went with both pets went through  check in at reception briefly  mentions to me can possibly be cancelled! sat down got called in to see  vet to be told its been  cancelled  due to staff shortage. Which is fine , these things happen  but i think if i was told in the morning it woyld have been less stressful for me the pets and my childern , to not be told and expected to wait in waiting area for the vet to tell me just didnt make sense.

I'm in a really tight financial position atm, so when my cats tooth got knocked out and she was visibly affected I was a bit worried about what a vets bill could end being. My friend recommended Shamrock St. My cat was booked in for the following week. Saw the vet who gave my cat a thorough mouth exam and told me she was looking very healthy. Appointment and meds cost me less than takeaway and now I've got peace of mind my cat is ok. Thanks.
Such an amazing place for people with Animals that can't afford private vet fees. They do run on donations though so help them out!
I was there on Wednesday with my old dog I want to a big thanks to you all you gave me all the support. It was very hard to see your we dog pass.

As a charitable organisation funds are limited which in cases limits treatments on offer but they are warm and friendly and have prolonged the life of my sickly dog... He however does not like visiting Shamrock St
God bless these caring people 🙏 if ever come in to a fortune I would donate so much …

Brilliant staff. Wait times can be long but with providing free and low cost care this can be expected. The staff are amazing patient and compassionate when dealing with euthanasia. I worried about having my pet put down and you made the whole process peaceful and gentle. The process of cremation was explained and everything made very easy especially at the worst time. I’m really grateful you gave my pet a really peaceful passing. I received my ashes by the end of the week and they were in a beautiful engraved urn and delivered by a really lovely and thoughtful courier. The vet was brilliant and the telephone staff very patient and kind.  I hope people donate as much as they can to help this place and what they do. Thank you.

Had to have my 20 yr old cat put down and they handled it brilliantly my pet was very relaxed and it was very peaceful. The vet was very compassionate and the process of receiving my cats ashes and the process was made very easy and she was back with me before the end of the week. I’m really grateful for this as it was something I was very fearful of. You guys were amazing even the telephone staff thank you. 🫡
Great service here.. parking very limited

Honestly can’t fault the PDSA. My boy Archie had to go in for eyelid correction surgery and I was so nervous about him going under anaesthetic due to his breed, the vet I spoke to was was so reassuring and explained everything to me in detail putting me at ease. My boy received amazing treatment and the vet and Nurses were so good with him giving him plenty of cuddles and attention. Thank you so much yous don’t receive enough credit for the wonderful job yous do 🤩
Excellent service very kind & sincere
The service & respect we’ve had has been incredible, very thankful for all they’ve done & the support offered after my cat sadly passed.
Great staff. Sometimes it’s a bit of a wait, but they are very busy.
Parking is shocking, always busy.
Great service for your pets

An absolute godsend to those who like me have been refused insurance on my dog and cannot afford 4 figure sums from private vets anytime something goes wrong.  You make an appointment,  they ask IF you want to make a donation (I donated £50 on each of my 3 visits) I would have been double my donation just for the medication I got on the 3 visits.

Dump of a place was told because my dog hasn't visited in the last 3 years it would need to be re registered and they aren't taking on any more pets. They let the nurse check her foot she said there may be a foreign object stuck in the foot but she can't do anything and I can't see a vet I was sent away.
Amazing service for people with pets but are on benefits or disability. Always give them a donation. These are real vets and other staff volunteering to bring us this service. Thank you guys. 👍 …
They do a great job for injured or sick animals, any injury or sickness needs to be an emergency though.  Still does inoculations and any questions you have they are happy to answer.
Waited 2 hours to be seen.Receptionist offhand

The staff and veterinary professionals provided exceptional care and assistance. My kitten's initial vaccinations were administered with great attention, and the experience was positive. Street parking is readily available.
Take brilliant care of your pets

Glasgow Animal Hospital in Shamrock Street.
Excellent staff and vets.
It's better to register your pet and phone for an appointment.
They took really good care of my cat Delta who had an ongoing illness.
The pdsa are amazing they are friendly empathetic and so kind and considerate to owners.  3specially when your fur baby goes to sleep x

I took my maltese dog to the PDSA pet hospital because she wouldn't eat and was being sick. The vets at the PDSA are excellent.  They thoroughly checked my do over and gave her scans, an injection to stop her being sick and medication for pain.
Great service for the community, vet's and staff are all amazing
This is the most amazing pet hospital every

We’re so grateful to the PDSA team for the incredible care and compassion they showed while trying to save our beloved cat, Pepsi. Even though he didn’t make it, we know they did everything they could. Their kindness during such a heartbreaking time meant the world to us. Thank you for being there for Pepsi and for us.

This is a new review due to my last visit here.
This PDSA told me my dog was on end-of-life care as his bladder stone was now a huge tumour, I knew my dog was far too fit and healthy to have a huge mass so got a second opinion, it was indeed the bladder stone, no mass there at all, they just didn't want to do the costly surgery, fair enough but why lie? they could have just told me they weren't able to pay for the surgery.
That was two years ago now and I still have my dog.

Only registered my wee dog and was seen within days of being accepted. Easy telephone appointment lovely receptionist I spoke to. The vet was very busy and running an hour behind which was fine as they are dealing with so many pets and doing their best to sort everyone especially emergencies. The triage vet nurse was great doing the obs and the vet nurse was amazing. All in all we were very satisfied with everything and very grateful for this service
Fantastic service for animals in need. An essential service. Thank you
Staff friendly and helpful great service
Staff were fantastic and really friendly, they were also still Incredibly efficient and attentive despite being busy.
Fantastic, friendly service. Very thorough and informative.

Had to take my sister's dog here, extremely busy place even if you have an appointment be prepared to wait, we waited just over an hour. There was alot of reactive dogs here so be careful have your dog on a short lead.
They are absolutely wonderful with your pet better than any vets i have been too in the past
staff amazing

I've been here a few times but never commented as I was just grateful for the help but today I have to say how amazing I thought the vet was today.  He took the time to explain so I could understand what was happening with L.A.s mass in her neck where as before I'd been told it's a mass and we don't deal with that.  You could see this guy's passion and he's a total treasure to PDSA and care of animals to come
always the friendliest, most caring staff. the pdsa have done so much for all my dogs and have saved my fur babies on many occasions, forever grateful!
Reduced vet care for people on Housing Benefit. Very caring staff and can get busy. Separate cat waiting area.

My wee pal Ember came here for his final sleep, my daughter Alison, her partner Ryan and myself were treated with utmost dignity and respect  by the lovely understanding and empathetic nurse, who's name I have unfortunately forgotten. The nurse explained the whole procedure to us before allowing us to spend more time with Ember, she came back to the room and asked if she could take Ember next door for a couple of minutes, when she returned she asked us if we would like another 5 minutes with Ember 😢💔 we said yes and she left us alone with him, when she came back she had some chicken for Ember and a blanket for him to lie on, she then asked if we were ready for her to go ahead 😢 Ember then went to sleep and the nurse told us to take as much time as we needed with him 💔 Alison asked if we could have some fur cutting and paw prints the nurse said that she would bring them out to us in the car park, they were presented to Alison with compassion and respect. From start to finish, this very difficult act was dealt with dignity, sympathy and care. 😢💔💔
Staff are friendly and helpful and amazing

My little dogs has had a skin condition since she was born , spent a fortune over the years trying get her some kind of help, been to various vets with not much help, and all it took was a couple of visits to the pdsa and they sorted her out with a massive difference, so many thanks to all at the pdsa on shamrock st you's are amazing

Thanks for everything you tried and greatful for the help you try to give me sadly he had to be  put to sleep thanks for understanding miss you so much I was heartbroken thanks for letting me spend his final moments with him xx❤️
Very attentive & professional
I've always been very happy with the service from PDSA. Thanks for helping me and my Lola. Thanks everyone at the PDSA
I took my daughter in-law to this pdsa with her dog,you honestly can't fault this place.The staff are so nice.
Quickly helped my two pets on emergency. Direct and dedicated ❤️ Waiting area always busy, not ideal for anxious/nervous dog

I had to have my beautiful cat put to sleep today as she was very unwell. The vet was lovely and very sympathetic. I need to say a special thank you to the young male nurse that was with me an Nala after she passed.  I think his name was Kyle ( sorry if name is wrong). He was so sweet with her.  He took the time  to take some paw prints for me and also gave me a bit of her fur in a little bottle.  He was absolutely brilliant and is definitely in the right profession.  Thank you so much for making a huge hard decision a little easier.  Xx

I would give 1000 stars if I could shamrock street is amazing vet practice if your struggling on benefits it is there to use nothing to be ashamed of asking for help and PDSA help you through what you need to bring as evedance and photo id the nursing staff and vets are amazing and rely on donations given a donation because they deserve to give help vets nurses and reseptionest amazing and take you through any treatment my dog is a barker I said so sorry for this the reseptionest sssaid don't worry it's a vets we are use to dogs and cats ect Shep likes to say hello amazing place 10000percent recommend and when Shep got bone stuck because he got into bin went to PDSA pets now and again amazing vets so nothing to be ashamed of asking for a bit of help much love to PDSA shamrock street

Mark and Shep
Grand job from these guys
Got my jab tails wagging
Great vets and nurses very good with care of your animals ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
A charity which helps animals
The standards employed are very high and the centenary surgeons are very thorough with their treatment even considering this human pandemic.
This vet is fantastic excellent with all my dogs can’t fault them so blessed it’s free
Very kind staff always happy to help.
Lovely staff Great vets

A lifeline for pet owners on a tight budget. Professional dedicated caring staff. Helped us through the loss of our loved pet cat lilly who was 14. Now looking after out new family members Kuro and Shiro. Our  new boys in the family. Give what you can afford take what you need. Glasgow needs the PDSA SHAMROCK ST.
